lines.zh: 我在山脊上走，翅膀半收。
lines.en: I walk the ridge with my wings half folded.

lines.zh: 恶地的红石被我踩出响声。
lines.en: The badlands' red stone rattles under me.

lines.zh: 我个子很高，影子能拉过一道沟。
lines.en: I'm tall; my shadow can cross a gully.

lines.zh: 我脚下悬着，走起来不沾土。
lines.en: I walk slightly aloft, never quite touching.
I pass between the peaks.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，看着峡谷下面。
lines.en: I stop at each step to look into the canyon.
My feathers turn over in the hot wind.
I pace slowly along the cliff edge.

lines.zh: 我收翅落地，走两步又浮起来。
lines.en: I fold, land, take two steps, and float again.

lines.zh: 我察觉不到地面的重量。
lines.en: The ground's weight never reaches me.

lines.zh: 我从山石的缝里飘过去。
lines.en: I drift through the gaps in the rock.

lines.zh: 我最后停在风口上，正对你。
lines.en: I stop in the wind gap, squared to you.

lines.zh: 我悬着，翅膀偶尔动一下。
lines.en: I hover, wings shifting now and then.
I'm up high, turning my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己是怎么被养大的。
lines.en: I don't know how I was raised.

lines.zh: 我把一只爪在另一只上磨了磨。
lines.en: I run one talon against the other.
I'm listening to the sounds below.

lines.zh: 我身上有几处旧伤，结了痂。
lines.en: A few old wounds have scabbed over.
I wait for wind. When it comes, I go.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，羽毛被吹得倒。
lines.en: I hold still and the wind flattens my feathers.

lines.zh: 我在看远处有没有同类。
lines.en: I look for others of my kind.
My eyes reach a long way.
I take a breath and my chest rises.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把脖子扭向另一边。
lines.en: I turn my neck slowly the other way.
I know the voice of the wind here.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀合拢，只留一线。
lines.en: I fold my wings, leaving only a sliver open.
You're below. I'm up here.
I look down and my shadow arrives first.
You smell of the surface world.
I don't come near people easily.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我就往后升一点。
lines.en: You reach out, so I rise a little.
I understand what taming means.

lines.zh: 你抬手的角度，像要抓我。
lines.en: The angle of your raised hand looks like a grab.
This mountain is my anchor point.

lines.zh: 你若坐得稳，我就在旁边坐。
lines.en: Sit still and I'll sit beside you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在看我的爪，不是脸。
lines.en: You're looking at my talons, not my face.

lines.zh: 我落下半格，离你近了些。
lines.en: I drop half a block closer.
If you leave, I won't follow yet.
This plumage of mine isn't soft.
I can't smell your intent.

lines.zh: 你退后，我就把翅膀松开。
lines.en: Step back and I'll loosen my wings.

lines.zh: 我在这里站了很久，你是第一个。
lines.en: I've stood here long. You're the first.
A patch of my plumage is disordered.
I sway in midair.

lines.zh: 我升了一格，避开下一击。
lines.en: I rise a block to clear the next blow.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我翅展不开。
lines.en: That left me unable to open my wings.
I can still fly. Don't underestimate me.
There's blood on my talons.

lines.zh: 我悬在原地，慢慢稳住翅膀。
lines.en: I hover in place and slowly steady my wings.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我爪尖发麻。
lines.en: The blow numbs my talon tips.
I tuck in to guard my chest.
I've cut that blow into my memory.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，我看见了。
lines.en: I see what's in your hand.
I descend a block.
I haven't smelled that before.
Set it down and step back first.
I'll wait for you to move off.
Is this of any use to me?
A little lower, and closer.

lines.zh: 我在挑剔，不太容易满足。
lines.en: I'm particular. Not easily pleased.

lines.zh: 你放在石上，退到风口外。
lines.en: Set it on the stone and step outside the wind gap.
Fine. That's mine then.

lines.zh: 你放下就走，别站那儿看。
lines.en: Put it down and go. Don't stand and watch.

lines.zh: 我认东西，也认给它的人。
lines.en: I judge the gift, and the one who gives it.
You hit me and I rise a block.
I barely notice it.

lines.zh: 别贴着我，我翅膀展不开。
lines.en: Don't crowd me. I can't open my wings.
I drift back half a metre, still aloft.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的手撞得生疼。
lines.en: That must have stung your hand.
I've gone around above you.
I sink a little and rise again.

lines.zh: 你撞在我翅骨上，我升了半格。
lines.en: You hit my wing bone and I rise half a block.
Your steps are raising dust.
Fine. I'll let it pass.
Few of my kind in these mountains.

lines.zh: 你得先证明你能守住一个锚点。
lines.en: First prove you can hold an anchor.

lines.zh: 我认一个主人，也认一个伴。
lines.en: I choose one master, and one companion.
First fly the ridge with me.
I don't like being held. Too heavy.

lines.zh: 山风好的时候，我心情也好。
lines.en: Good mountain wind puts me in good temper.

lines.zh: 你要是掉下去，我不会接。
lines.en: If you fall, I won't catch you.
That was a joke. You've gone pale.

lines.zh: 我不擅长温柔，只擅长守着。
lines.en: I'm poor at gentleness, good at guarding.

lines.zh: 夜里的山顶，比下面干净。
lines.en: The peak at night is cleaner than below.
I dip and hook it with a talon.
It's tiny in my talon.
I toss it and catch it.

lines.zh: 爪子不太灵活，掉了两次。
lines.en: My grip is clumsy. Dropped it twice.
I carry it aloft.
I set it on a rock ledge and study it.
So heavy my talons slip.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿没有光的味道。
lines.en: This has no taste of light.

lines.zh: 我用爪尖把它挑到岩台上。
lines.en: I flick it onto the rock ledge with a talon tip.
Keep it. It may be useful.
A shadow moved below.
My wings open halfway.

lines.zh: 从这个高度，我什么都看得见。
lines.en: From this height I see everything.
That's not one of my kind.
I drop and circle above it.
I judge how many feet it still has.

lines.zh: 好，我在这个角度出手最好。
lines.en: Good. This angle suits my strike.

lines.zh: 它抬头的时候已经晚了。
lines.en: It looked up too late.
Karatenmon's claws come out.
The wind runs with me.
I hold this anchor.
You've backed to the rock face. No way left.
I hover above it, descending slowly.

lines.zh: 它的影子在我的视线里。
lines.en: Its shadow lies inside my sight.
Each circuit takes me lower.
It goes left; I circle left.

lines.zh: 这个高度，它的武器够不到。
lines.en: At this height its weapon can't reach.
No hurry. I have all the wind I need.
My technique takes a while to build.
Its breathing is going ragged.
I cut in from behind.
A little higher and the strike's cleaner.
Its feet are slipping in place.
The mountain wall blocks its retreat.
Spread, my wings raise a wind.

lines.zh: 这一下带着我从上面来的力。
lines.en: That carried the weight of my descent.
I spin up a small whirlwind.
Mach Tornado. Take it.
The wind shoves it back half a step.
My wingtip cuts across its pauldron.
Not heavy, but I don't stop.
I come down on it from above.
Its attack hit nothing.
I pull up to find a new angle.
Harder than the last.
It withdrew. I don't give chase.

lines.zh: 我在峰尖上出现，风先到。
lines.en: I appear above the peak. The wind comes first.
I never quite land. I keep hovering.

lines.zh: 这里是恶地，石头是红的。
lines.en: Badlands here. The stone is red.

lines.zh: 我从峰尖落下，风托住羽毛。
lines.en: I drop from the peak; the wind holds my feathers.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀第一次展开，很响。
lines.en: My wings open for the first time. Loudly.

lines.zh: 我选了一块最高的岩做锚点。
lines.en: I choose the highest rock for my anchor.

lines.zh: 我把身体立直，比石柱还高。
lines.en: I straighten up taller than the pillars.

lines.zh: 山风从三面来，我转了一圈。
lines.en: Wind from three sides. I turn a full circle.
I shake my feathers and dust falls.

lines.zh: 热风把我的影子吹斜了。
lines.en: The hot wind tilts my shadow.
I fly one circuit to see the boundaries.

lines.zh: 锚点附近，我熟悉每一块石头。
lines.en: Near my anchor I know every stone.

lines.zh: 火一燎，羽毛的尖端卷了。
lines.en: Fire curls the tips of my feathers.
A fall can't hurt me. Only my dignity.

lines.zh: 水里我飞不起来，翅膀太重。
lines.en: In water I can't fly. My wings weigh too much.

lines.zh: 冲击把我在空中推了个圈。
lines.en: The blast spins me in the air.
An arrow passes through my flight feathers.
That force weighs down my wings.
Too long hungry and I can't fly fast.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我浑身羽毛都立着。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and every feather stands up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有空气，我托不住自己。
lines.en: No air in the void. Nothing holds me up.
